---
name: "Propose an additional module"
about: "Suggest a research-backed extension that supports the educational mission."
title: "[MODULE PROPOSAL] "
---

New modules are welcome for consideration when they make reliable health evidence easier to understand, particularly across populations, without pretending to diagnose or prescribe.

**Proposed module and intended users:**

**What question would this help someone discuss with a clinician or dietitian?**

**Why this belongs in Ancestry Health:** (how it strengthens—not obscures—the core weight and population-aware education mission)

**Research basis:** (primary studies, guidelines, existing evidence gaps; what is established versus exploratory)

**Proposed inputs and outputs:** (identify which are optional, what stays educational, what is explicitly withheld)

**Ancestry/genetic assumptions:** (explain how personal identity, population associations and validated genotype are kept separate)

**Safety, privacy and accessibility considerations:** (including whether new sensitive information or data storage would be needed; default is browser-only and data-minimizing)

**Scope and alternatives:** (could a research article or explanatory card answer the question without building a new calculator?)

**Validation and review plan:** (independent source assessment, relevant specialist review for high-impact claims, tests, user-comprehension considerations)

**Related issues or dependencies:**

**Conflicts of interest or affiliations:** (optional background; disclose material financial/product interests)

A proposal is an invitation to discuss feasibility; it is not permission to add personalized treatment advice or alter the protected weight formulas.
